en.title: Final -ă Stays Clear
en.summary: Learn how to pronounce the final vowel ă clearly without dropping it at the end of Romanian words.

sections.title: The sound
paragraphs: Look at the letter ă at the end of a word. It sounds like the last sound in 'sofa'. You hear it clearly. It never disappears. Listen to the word (lampă) /ˈlam.pə/, which means lamp. The ending is soft, but you must say it completely.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Relax your mouth and keep your jaw slightly open. Keep your tongue flat in the middle of your mouth. Make a short, relaxed sound with your voice. Do not push your lips forward. Let the air flow out smoothly and gently.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: When you see the letter ă at the end, always pronounce it. Most words put the stress on the syllable before it. For example, listen to (apă) /ˈa.pə/, which means water. The first part is louder, but the last vowel is still clear and audible.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not swallow or drop the last sound. Some learners stop speaking too early and cut the word short. Never turn it into a sharp 'a' sound either. Keep it calm and distinct. Always finish the whole word with this gentle vowel.
